title: Stage-3 REQ-4: lock 2 — bv-semantics mutation (kill check at width)
description: The mutation battery (forge/src/mutation.rs) runs against bv semantics for tagged clauses. The frozen operator catalogue (MUTANT_CAP=64, mutation.rs:61) is reused UNCHANGED — the stage-1 re-elaboration precedent: only the kill check swaps. classify_mutant's oracle (mutation.rs:99) is evaluated AT WIDTH, so a wrap-exploiting mutant (equivalent at unbounded semantics, distinguishable at width) must be killable by a wrap-aware check. AC-5: a wrap-exploiting mutant is killed by the bv-semantics mutation run on a tagged clause AND survives the unbounded check — a fixture test pinning the width-aware kill. Doc: REQ-4. Gate: G3.
